description: Hereditary finiteness is equivalent to finite rank and membership in the omega stage.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.CumulativeHierarchy.hereditarilyFinite_iff.{u} (x : ZFSet.{u}) :
  (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.CumulativeHierarchy.HereditarilyFinite x ↔ x.rank < Ordinal.omega0) ∧
    (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.CumulativeHierarchy.HereditarilyFinite x ↔ x ∈ ZFSet.vonNeumann Ordinal.omega0)
